title: Source package quality and maintained method interfaces
summary: Extend existing Ruff and partial mypy checks to the whole source package, with typed service signatures, a shared storage boundary and one interface for the two maintained experiment methods.
decision_provenance: The user requested modern static checking, linting, formatting and practical abstractions. The assistant selected strict package-wide mypy, additional Ruff rules, the storage extraction and the ExperimentMethod protocol; these implementation choices were not separately recorded as user decisions.
findings: Ruff already covered source and tests; mypy originally named only four source modules.
Preparation, scoring, replay and viewing dispatch was repeated across the CLI and workflow for landmark and portable-package methods.
Extensible research documents retain runtime schema validators; static checking does not certify arbitrary JSON fields or optional model-runtime internals.
The copied reproduction runner and segmentation adapter retain their standalone execution contracts.

followups.summary: The user requested an audit, fixes and polish against TB3_CODING_STYLE.md and allowed simplifying it into canonical guidance. The assistant reviewed the current checkout and the completed typed-Harbor branch, reused its implementation, and made docs/coding-style.md the maintained guide. Implementation choices below are assistant decisions, not separate user approvals.

prior_work.integration: Applied reviewed code and lockfile changes from the completed local branch without moving branches or changing the shared Git index.

findings: Strict mypy passed at baseline, but Document hid fixed Harbor result fields and task validation returned four positional values. ImportedTrial, typed case/evidence helpers, ParsedCases, ResultState and ValidatedTask now expose those contracts.
Projection previously required a workspace read. project_records now accepts loaded records and a pending review without mutating its inputs; extensible scientific fields remain accepted.
Workflow storage calls now name storage directly. Existing core re-exports remain for other callers.

Historical timestamps remain opaque objects with unchanged truthiness and serialized values. New closed normalized models reject missing/extra fields and unintended coercion; existing research records keep their current validators.
Ten synthetic baseline fixtures pin imported JSON, collected JSON, observation identity, warnings and result states to b7b9717. They are regression witnesses, not medical evidence.
Digest encodings, path policies, standalone reproduction code, generated browser contracts and experiment-local algorithms intentionally retain separate ownership.

review.summary: A follow-up review found that finite-number normalization raised OverflowError for oversized JSON integers. Such rewards and token counts now normalize to unavailable values; the trial remains inspectable with no scoring verdict. Synthetic baseline fixtures were retained unchanged.
review.regressions: Added positive and negative oversized-integer coverage. Tightened baseline assertions to compare serialized values, persisted evaluation text and the complete raw-file inventory.
review.commit_scope: Canonical style guide, typed Harbor and workflow contracts, pure projection, dependencies and their regressions. Prior frontend and architecture-discussion edits remain separately owned.

followups.reopen_when: A maintained consumer needs a narrower record or method-result schema, or a shared scientific primitive has matching semantics and a preservation plan. Broad record migration and universal scoring models remain out of scope.

reopen_when: A third maintained method needs these operations, stable record fields justify stronger schema types, or a runtime dependency can be checked without provisioning model environments.
